comments.text: From .22.2: the quoted-source walkers in src/compiler2/source.rs (the read_list_tail_ref loops near :1025 and :1038, used for quoted-list compare and to-vec) refuse a terminator loudly with ExpectedTag. An improper list can reach quoted source only as a value inside it (Macro.escape([1 | 2]) gives [{:|, [], [1, 2]}], a proper list), so this ticket decides whether those walkers need the improper form.
